# Development Guide

This guide explains how to use the different components of this template.

## Prerequisites

{% if 'python' in components %}
### Python Environment

- Install [uv](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv) for Python package management
- Install [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) for documentation rendering (required for Great Docs)
- Install dependencies: `uv sync --all-groups`
- Install prek hooks: `uv tool install prek` then `prek install --hook-type pre-commit --hook-type pre-push`

{% endif %}

## Component Guides

{% if 'python' in components %}
### Python Development

#### Running Tests

Run all tests with coverage:
```bash
prek run --all-files --hook-stage pre-push
```

Or run pytest directly:
```bash
uv run pytest
```

#### Test Coverage

- View local HTML report: Open `htmlcov/index.html` in your browser
- Coverage is automatically generated on every test run
- Minimum coverage threshold: 80% (configurable in pyproject.toml)

#### Code Quality

- **Type checking**: `uv run ty` (if ty is configured)
- **Linting**: `uv run ruff check .`
- **Formatting**: `uv run ruff format .`

{% endif %}

{% if 'nix' in components %}
### Nix Development

#### Development Shell

Enter the Nix development shell:
```bash
nix develop
```

This provides all the tools and dependencies defined in `flake.nix`.

#### Nix Tools

- **Format**: `nix fmt`
- **Lint**: `nix run nixpkgs/statix -- check`
- **Dead code check**: `nix run nixpkgs/deadnix -- .`

{% endif %}

{% if 'git' in components %}
### Git Configuration

The template includes:
- `.gitattributes` for file handling and line endings
- `.gitmessage` for commit message template

These files are automatically included when you initialize a git repository.

{% endif %}

{% if 'agents' in components %}
### Agent Skills

The template includes a collection of skills in `.agents/skills/`:
- **curator**: Documentation maintenance
- **leader**: Project leadership
- **reviewer**: Code review
- **worker**: General development
- Plus 38 Matt Pocock skills for various development tasks

To use these skills, configure your agent to load skills from the `.agents/skills/` directory.

{% endif %}

{% if 'docs' in components %}
### Documentation

#### Building Docs

Build the documentation site:
```bash
uv run great-docs build
```

Preview locally:
```bash
uv run great-docs preview
```

#### Documentation Structure

- **User Guide**: All content in `docs/` directory
- **Architecture**: Architecture overview and ADRs in `docs/architecture/`
- **Development**: This guide and development standards
- **Reference**: Glossary and reference materials
- **Test Coverage**: View coverage report at `/coverage/` in the built site

{% endif %}

{% if 'renovate' in components %}
### Dependency Updates (Renovate)

Renovate is configured to automatically update dependencies:

#### Configuration Levels

- **minimal**: Only opens PRs, does NOT auto-merge
- **patch**: Auto-merges patch updates
- **minor**: Auto-merges patch and minor updates  
- **yolo**: Auto-merges ALL updates (patch, minor, major)

#### Common Settings

All levels:
- Refuse updates newer than 7 days
- Group dependencies together
- {% if 'nix' in components %}Also maintains Nix flake files{% endif %}
- {% if 'python' in components %}Also maintains Python dependencies (pyproject.toml, uv.lock){% endif %}

{% endif %}

## Workflow

{% if 'python' in components %}
1. Install dependencies: `uv sync --all-groups`
2. Install prek hooks: `uv tool install prek && prek install --hook-type pre-commit --hook-type pre-push`
3. Develop your code
4. Run tests: `prek run --all-files --hook-stage pre-push` (runs on pre-push automatically)
5. {% if 'docs' in components %}Build docs: `uv run great-docs build`{% endif %}

{% endif %}

{% if 'git' in components %}
## Git Hooks

The template uses [Prek](https://github.com/prek/prek) for git hooks:
- Hooks are organized by component and stage
- Only active components have their hooks installed
- Run `prek install --hook-type pre-commit --hook-type pre-push` to set up hooks

{% endif %}
